name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate

name: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate

name: Salesforce Certified Tableau Data Analyst

name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03)
description: Validates ability to design secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-optimized architectures on AWS.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (Exam AZ-104)

name: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer

name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

name: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer (Exam 1Z0-830)

name: CompTIA Security+

name: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)

name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

name: ACCA Qualification (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants)

name: Financial Risk Manager (FRM)

name: Project Management Professional (PMP)

name: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

name: ASQ Certified Six Sigma Green Belt (CSSGB)

name: IIBA Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA)

name: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Professional Certificate

name: HubSpot Academy Inbound Marketing Certification

name: SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM-CP)
description: Credential for operational HR professionals on behavioral competencies and HR knowledge.
